description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'VacancyListRestControllerTest' for testing the 'VacancyListRestController' and related REST API endpoints of the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes setup methods, various test cases for GET requests with different parameters, and tests for unimplemented methods expecting exceptions.
